cases.description: Two variants add the same product at different places (one with a note); they share one added slot and, with equal amounts, one option keyed and shaped by the first variant's row.

202 ml is exactly 1 % above the base 200 ml and 201 ml is inside, so both join the base option; 203 ml opens a new option, and 204.9 ml joins it because it is within 1 % of that option's first-seen 203 ml (not of the base).
Removing base rows gives their slots a 'none' option; two variants that remove the same row share it.
The second added row is inserted after the first added row (afterId = an add of the same variant); added slots follow the base slots in first-seen order.

A variant swaps a utensil (removed ones drop out, added ones are appended) and overrides both times; another overrides only the prep time with 0, which is a value, not 'inherit'. Ingredients are untouched, so every slot has one option.
An optional 'do smaku' ingredient and a first prep step are added at the very start (afterId null); a null amount keys its option with 'x'. The base has no prep time, so setting one is an override.

cases.description: Changing only the note or the optional flag is a modify op, but the option (product + amount) stays the base's, so the matrix shows the base row as the option ingredient.
Three variants swap śmietana 18% for śmietanka 30%: 250 ml and 1 glass (also 250 ml) share one option, 330 ml gets its own; each variant records the swap for preference scoring.

Step ops per section: replace a prep step, remove the last instruction, add one instruction at the start and one (with a photo) after a kept base step. Replaces/removes come first in base order, adds follow in edited order.
500 g re-entered as 0.5 kg is a modify op (the entered quantity changed), but the base amount is equal, so the matrix keeps a single option with the base row.
Moving a base ingredient is a remove plus an add: the base slot gets 'none' for the variant and the product also gets an added slot (p:), where the base is 'none'.
100 g of oil (0.92 g/ml) is 108.6957 ml; the option key rounds it to 3 decimals ('…:108.696'), and 8.7 % more than the base is a separate option.
One variant combines modify, swap, remove, add, step remove/add, a utensil and both times; a second one shares its amount option within 1 % (603 g vs 600 g) and appears in 'none' of the added slot.
